title: Make a zero-duration widget publication cancel an active older transition
rationale: Original .5.1 and docs/api.md promise instant transition_ms0. A source-qualified active-animation path currently ignores the new parameters until the old animation lands. This is a production behavior gap, not an executed failing test.
description: At audited582e, publish gauge level0, then level1 with200ms; render at0 and advance the injected clock100ms so the visible value is about0.5. Publish level0 with transition_ms0 and render without advancing time. Expected: immediately draw0, cancel that instance animation, and stop widget-only wake/raster work. Current source: sync_widget_textures starts/replaces an animation only for positive duration, then resolve_animated_params reads the old animation.to_params and upload_texture preserves it. Predicted visible value remains about0.5 and the old1 target continues. This exact scenario has not been executed by the audit. Public gRPC supplies transition_ms and MCP supplies0, so a MCP update can hit the same compositor path after a gRPC transition. Repair only this instant-retarget behavior and the trustworthiness of its existing fixture.
design: Authority: full parent5/.5.1 original contract, docs/api.md transition semantics, docs/invariants.md6/9 and docs/vision.md cheap idle. Do not add a publication clock, schema or state framework. title: Restore the original dev-only multidimensional work counter contract

description: Reconcile .5.3 original four-dimension dev-mode observation with the actual current three-field repaint record. WorkCounts currently contains tiles_redrawn:u32,pixels_damaged:u64,full_frame:bool; compositor RetainedRenderState.latest_work and both full/scoped writes are ungated; compositor and telemetry have no feature tables, and runtime dev-mode=[] does not propagate counting. Original layout/raster/upload observations are absent. The existing canonical one-node/fallback/overlap/idle gates exercise useful repaint behavior, so retain that real behavior and its assertions while delivering the authorized measurement boundary and dimensions. Do not remove WorkCounts merely because its drain has only test readers; the production writes are live and .5.3 is its retained counter owner.
design: Authority is full .5.3 description/design (explicit four fields and dev-mode), parent5, current docs/vision.md proportional work and scope Working rules. Current exact owners: telemetry/src/work_counts.rs11 and lib.rs13/37; compositor/src/renderer/retained.rs45 private latest_work, begin_observation_frame118, scoped observation154, full observation177 and public take_work_counts189. frame.rs full/retained headless callers own real submission. Exactly9 current drain call expressions exist:7 inline runtime headless tests and2 compositor retained_image tests; no production/benchmark/T7 drain call exists. This does not erase the live producer. Restore documented four work dimensions through real existing preparation/raster/upload/damage owner operations, with explicit integer units and per-frame reset/drain semantics. Define exact four units without a new measurement framework: layout:u64 is the per-frame delta of existing TextRasterizer.shape_call_count (cache-miss shaping invocations, text.rs759/1628); raster:u64 is the sum of existing per-instance raster_count deltas (entered rasterize_and_upload invocations, not guaranteed successful rasters); upload:u64 counts actual widget RGBA queue.write_texture submissions at widget.rs2912; damage_px:u64 is clipped repaint-region pixels from PixelRect.area. Preserve the existing three repaint fields as supplemental observations with their9 current real test consumers; they never replace the four required dimensions. Keep raw existing shaping/raster counters live and unchanged; only the new WorkCounts observation/storage/writes/drain is dev/test opt-in. This narrowly defines existing measurable operations, not all glyphon/resource/static-image GPU uploads. A zero upload field therefore means zero observed widget RGBA submissions and never certifies an empty atlas/upload queue. Reuse existing per-instance widget raster counters/last-sync plumbing; never infer layout/raster/upload by copying tiles_redrawn, fabricate0 for an unobserved dimension, or claim a general no-upload result from the AB/BA glyph-inventory fixture. External glyphon work that cannot be observed must be explicitly bounded/documented, not silently counted as measured. Keep the current tiles_redrawn/pixels_damaged/full_frame repaint/fallback assertions and readers as explicit supplemental dev observations. This retains a current user rather than deleting instrumentation to make the type spelling match. Gate the observation storage/writes/hook and reexports behind dev/test configuration, propagate an opt-in existing dev-mode path through runtime/compositor/telemetry, and make existing selected tests opt in without changing the normal app default closure or silently dropping their targets. Counter gating must not disable retained rendering, its snapshots, widget/frame telemetry, cache work or GPU submission. Do not recreate the removed invalidation artifact or grow a certification API. Update all9 exact readers and existing canonical_one_node_update_repaints_only_the_changed_tile, transparent-overlap/fallback/recovery, static/no-render and new_observation_clears_prior_frame_work_counts assertions to observe the real dimensions/retained pixel behavior. Existing names stay. Correct telemetry lib stale Soak/DR-V8 module claim as part of this current counter documentation; .5.4 removed that owner. This is not a new soak.

Fresh qualified all-root default/dev/test/target/dependency inventory proves four actual count dimensions, units, producer operations, per-frame reset/drain and all9 current readers/reexports; current useful repaint behavior and pixel assertions remain. 2. Transparent overlap includes the required contributor, unsupported/degradation/device-recovery paths retain full-frame correctness, and a new observation cannot return prior-frame counters. 4. title: Make retained split-input budget fixtures measure event-bearing runtime frames
rationale: Original .5.5 keeps the applicable independent budget assertions; the accepted GEN1 contract audits their real sample provenance. The existing scene-commit and next-present conditions execute over zero/plumbing fields, so command success leaves their measurement obligation unresolved. Related publish-admission metrics do not repair these input-triggered fields.
description: At audited source5825a05421a9e588edd5c3c05ebf7f5bac36c0e1, retain and make meaningful the existing test_input_to_scene_commit_p99_within_budget and test_input_to_next_present_p99_within_budget measurement gates. Source-derived zero/plumbing limitation: FrameTelemetry::new initializes mutations_applied=0 (record.rs228), the qualified compositor frame constructors have no writer for that field, and HeadlessRuntime gates both returned input_to_scene_commit_us/input_to_next_present_us on compositor_telemetry.mutations_applied>0 (headless.rs525-543). scene-commit fixture243-305 explicitly has no live mutation; next-present324-386 warms then renders20 unchanged frames. Their successful assertions do not establish measured input/agent-to-commit or input-to-present conformance. This is source inference, not a numeric value emitted by the executed log. Expected: an actual runtime input followed by the controlled accepted scene response and the frame carrying that response supplies bounded, nonempty, event-bearing samples with genuine start/commit/submit boundaries; unchanged/no-input frames remain zero and do not masquerade as measured conformance. Current:30 scene-commit samples from a no-mutation fixture and20 next-present samples from unchanged frames can satisfy upper bounds through constructor-zero fields. The existing log passed30 tests/eight enabled branches and printed only3 other numeric values; neither of these two silent values was emitted. This is an UNEXECUTED source-qualified falsification, not an emitted zero counterexample. Do not repair by merely setting mutations_applied, copying scene.version differences or treating frame_start as input arrival.
design:
Authority: full original hud-bstmy.5.5 design keeps independent budget assertions that still apply; canonical hud-bstmy.5.7 requires actual sample/conditional-budget/instrument adjudication. Current record.rs split-input documentation defines input arrival -> commit of the response -> submission of the containing frame, with0 absent input/response. Retired validation-framework text is historical navigation, not new authority. Preserve the existing field names/types/zero defaults, budgets, normal/default dependency closure, named tests and weekly lane.
Exact owners: FrameTelemetry::new and split fields in telemetry/record.rs105-134/205-235; HeadlessRuntime::render_frame Stage1-4 at400-450 (no OS drain and already-committed mutations), actual compositor submit at461 and rebuilt record525-543; compositor frame.rs constructors/real submit; vertical_slice budget_assertions.rs243-386. Existing production pointer dispatch records PendingInputLatencySample at windowed/lifecycle.rs2054, existing record_pending_input_latency/drain_pending_input_latency600-653 carries actual monotonic input timestamps, and windowed/mod.rs2089-2097 writes the split fields after its real Stage4/submission boundaries. These are the actual existing input timing owner, not evidence that every windowed sample includes a causally related agent response. lifecycle::pending_input_latency_drains_into_split_latency_fields2546 proves helper ordering/one drain; its supplied timestamps do not prove an OS/GPU/agent loop. event_loop_harness deliberately has no GPU and cannot alone certify a present.
Keep ordinary no-input HeadlessRuntime fields0. Make the two retained fixtures drive one controlled real input -> accepted scene mutation -> frame path, reusing InputProcessor and the existing windowed pending-input timing core and actual runtime mutation/render owner. Extract/reuse only the existing private timestamp/drain boundary where necessary, with production callers using that same core; never write fields or queue timestamps directly merely to satisfy a test. The fixture must show that the accepted mutation corresponds to its injected event by its controlled request/result or batch identity and that the measured frame contains the changed content. Do not assume any arbitrary pending pointer event plus unrelated batch is an agent response. If headless processing cannot consume an input/response in the current owner path, drive the existing production timing core with the real input/mutation/submission path rather than relabel its frame-start proxy; no reconstructed frame pipeline, fake compositor mutation count or unconditional nonzero fallback. The timestamp starts before actual input processing, commit is after the controlled accepted response is applied, and completion is after the frame carrying it is submitted. Local headless submission is explicitly a local boundary, not Windows surface.present/scanout or a real network roundtrip. Keep those physical limits visible rather than asserting true photon or general remote-agent conformance.
Extend only the two existing vertical_slice fixtures to require the intended positive sample population, actual input/accepted mutation/visible response identity and timestamp ordering before p99. Require nonzero event-bearing observations and exact sample counts; idle/no-input and rejected/no-response operations must not create misleading response samples. Keep the existing 30 scene-commit and20 next-present observations, warmup excluded, and other28 structural/pixel/latency cases intact. Emit the actual count and p99 for these selected fields when their existing hard branches run; no synthetic values or changed thresholds. Extend the nearest existing pending_input_latency_drains_into_split_latency_fields only for changed same-owner drain/error/reset behavior needed by the reused core. Net expected +0 ~3 -0; no additional harness/species/source guard. Preserve real collector order and all other frame/raster/stage/timestamp/p99 instrumentation.
The feature-free production path must carry real event context, not a dev-only setter that leaves the actual caller uninstrumented. Keep context private, per-frame and bounded by actual outstanding events; avoid persistent per-surface probes/histograms/admin keys/new clocks/wake cadence. No wire/config/auth/agents change. An unavailable response is absence, not a zero-valued successful latency sample. Other agents, failed mutations, delayed responses, skipped frames and replayed responses must not be charged as the selected event or re-use a consumed sample. Serialize the shared headless/record edits with W3; no semantic dependency on its closure.
